newGames.pitch: Stop the light in the window. Three rounds. Small build, sets the cabinet style.
Two moving shelves, coins you drop, a tray that pays. Your machine keeps its state between visits.
One pool position a day, one shot to clear it. Runs on the 8-ball engine.
Four to eight players, 90-second rounds, most bumps wins. Built from swerve's cars.
Nine boardwalk holes, a new course each day, friends compared on one card.
Toss rings at a crate of bottles. Short, physical, good on a phone.
